name: Board-marked concrete
summary: Concrete cast in rough timber forms, so that the grain and the joints of the boards stay on the surface.
how: Use sawn boards 100 to 150 mm wide for the formwork.
Leave the surface as it comes from the form: no paint and no plaster.
Let the board joints run in one direction on each wall.

origin.note: Le Corbusier completes the Unité d'Habitation with walls and piers of raw, board-marked concrete.

adoptions.via: Loft interiors and restaurants cast board-marked concrete walls and counters.
